title: PM Modi, UAE Crown Prince discuss new sovereign fund L'Imad, strategic cooperation; Malaysia ties reviewed
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and UAE Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed discussed the role of L'Imad, the UAE's newest sovereign investment fund, in expanding bilateral ties, alongside cooperation in defence, space, nuclear energy and technology. Modi separately reviewed India-Malaysia ties with PM Anwar Ibrahim, including semiconductors, trade, defence and investment.

title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Weak technical setup to keep bulls under pressure
summary: The technical structure has deteriorated following the violation of the important 23,900–24,000 support zone. This area had provided support during the recent consolidation but will now be expected to act as resistance on any pullback. More importantly, Nifty has slipped below its 100-week moving average, currently placed at 24,401, and remains below the 50-week MA at 24,673.

title: US determines anti dumping, countervailing duty on Indian solar cells, panels
summary: The US has finalized duties on solar cells and panels imported from India. Anti-dumping and countervailing duties were set for several Indian companies. Investigations into crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells are ongoing. The US International Trade Commission will determine injury to American manufacturers. This development occurs as India and the US negotiate a bilateral trade agreement.
